name: Naledi Mokoena
headline: Senior People & HR Operations Manager
summary: Senior HR Operations professional with 8 years of experience driving recruiting strategy, HRIS optimization, and people analytics initiatives across mid-sized and growing organizations. Skilled in building scalable HR processes, partnering with leadership on workforce planning, and using data-driven insights to improve retention and employee experience. Based in Cape Town with a strong foundation in South African labour law and multinational team support.

responsibilities: Lead end-to-end recruiting operations for technical and commercial teams across three regions
Own HRIS administration and data integrity for a workforce of 350+ employees
Build and maintain people analytics dashboards to track attrition, headcount, and hiring funnel metrics
Partner with senior leadership on workforce planning and organizational design
Manage compliance with South African labour legislation and internal HR policy updates
Supported recruiting cycles for mid-level and senior hires across finance and operations departments
Administered and improved HRIS workflows to reduce manual data entry errors
Generated monthly people analytics reports for department heads
Advised managers on performance management and employee relations matters
Coordinated onboarding programs for new hires across two office locations
Assisted with full-cycle recruiting including screening, interviewing, and offer coordination
Maintained employee records and updated HRIS system entries
Supported payroll input verification and benefits administration
Handled first-line employee queries and escalated complex cases appropriately
